provenance.subject: narrow card: each artifact's own content predicate over its own scope drives its own row

repository_state.note: the pre-bump mains named by the design; the repository half of CapturedArtifact (manifest_version, content_changed, derivation) is captured at these SHAs by the normalizer, NOT supplied by this file

expected.note: a resolver emitting any other version fails this fixture; ac-image's row is derived independently from AC's own scope, never from the awid movement

awid-image.anchor_versions.0.5.15.note: resolves to the same commit as awid-service-v0.5.15; the two artifacts are tagged together at one commit, which is what the awid card equality invariant asserts

awid-image.members.ghcr.io/awebai/awid.o.source: the source SHA of tag awid-v0.5.15, which the publisher stamps as the image's source-revision label
awid-image.members.ghcr.io/awebai/awid.o.warning: GHCR manifest reads need a registry token, which this authoring pass did not have. This is the value the publisher is contracted to stamp, not a value read back off the registry. R6 must either re-observe it with a token or accept it as intended-value. It is NOT null: the ghcr member kind DOES expose a source identity, and writing null here would silently convert an unobserved identity into the identityless case that drives provisional recoverability.

ac-image.members.ghcr.io/awebai/ac.occup.source: AC commit efd19f41bf6699264e6a7813df19c4b0070eb4a3, the 0.7.14-era anchor named by the design's B1 movement evidence
ac-image.members.ghcr.io/awebai/ac.occup.warning: same GHCR-token limitation as above; the anchor for ac-image is the OCI revision label, so this identity is exactly what the stamper round makes checkable

ac-image.anchor_versions.0.7.14.source: AC repository: backend/pyproject.toml at efd19f41 declares version 0.7.14, and at 47060200 still declares 0.7.14 (pre-bump), so efd19f41 is a valid 0.7.14 anchor for the diff

independent_rederivation.claim: the design's B1 AC movement evidence: 14 files in the whole diff, 5 under backend/src + backend/tests
independent_rederivation.command: git diff --name-only efd19f41 47060200 | wc -l  and  ... | grep -E '^backend/(src|tests)/' | wc -l
independent_rederivation.note: matches the corrected figure in the critic's amendment (7 -> 5). Re-derived from the AC repository rather than copied from the design text, so this fixture and the design agree by measurement and not by transcription. The exhaustive in-scope count is fixed by the canonical content_scope field, and the fixture binds to that field rather than to this count.

controls.note: B1's two controls are REPOSITORY-half, not registry-half, so they need no separate registry fixture: (1) the same SHAs with each artifact's scope content anchored at its own prior tag/label must yield normal form; (2) an AC variant WITHOUT scope changes since its anchor must yield no AC row in the patch. Both vary content_changed, which the normalizer captures from the pinned SHAs. Do not encode them here by editing occupancy - that would test a different thing.
